papers.abstract: LLM-based workflows compose specialized agents to execute complex tasks, and these agents usually share substantial context, allowing KV-Cache reuse to save computation. papers.abstract: For years, we have built LLM serving systems like any other critical infrastructure: a single general-purpose stack, hand-tuned over many engineer-years, meant to support every model and workload. papers.abstract: Caching and reusing intermediate features across consecutive frames is a common technique to reduce redundant computation and transmission for edge-cloud video analytics in mobile edge computation.
